scope: Bounded authority consistency comparison across six countries/seven classes; inventory only. No masters, catalogue, metadata, streams, EPG or rights edits.
policy_application: Same functional first-level/combined-territorial regional-ordinance threshold; no sovereign-or-Act-title requirement, no blanket council inclusion, municipal exclusion retained.
finding: The Czech/Croatian asymmetry was not justified by the retained sources. Correct Croatian county/Zagreb scope and Budapest’s separate combined territorial-capital scope; keep materially narrower coordination/local-administration exclusions with accurate powers wording.

sources.title: Czech Constitution, Articles 99–105
sources.finding: Higher territorial units are constitutionally distinct from municipalities; assemblies have their own budgets and Article 104(3) generally binding ordinances within their jurisdiction. Article 105 separately addresses delegated state administration.
sources.currentness_limits: Parliament-hosted text lists amendments through 2013. Article 104 is not a claim that regional duties can be imposed without a statutory basis.

sources.title: Ministry-hosted English Regions Act 129/2000, sections 1–8
sources.finding: Sections 2,4 distinguish independent competence from delegated state functions. Section 6 allows assembly regulations imposing obligations only where stipulated by law; section 7 separately concerns delegated executive directives. Section 8 provides promulgation and legal effect.
sources.currentness_limits: Downloaded primary ministry PDF,10 pages, translation incorporating amendments through 2002. Used with retained baseline and Constitution; not a full 2026 procedural consolidation.

sources.title: Constitutional Act 347/1997, higher self-governing units
sources.finding: The listed higher territorial units include Prague. Combined regional capacity is the relevant comparison, not ordinary municipal councils.
sources.currentness_limits: Parliament-hosted text indicates 2011 amendments; reader character encoding is degraded. Existing 14 IDs retained; no new territorial count inferred.

sources.title: Croatian Constitution, Articles 133–138
sources.finding: Counties are regional self-government units, distinct from municipalities/towns; Zagreb may have county status. Broad regional affairs, autonomous internal organisation, legality-only state oversight and own revenues are constitutionally protected.
sources.currentness_limits: Official parliamentary English consolidated text; no later procedural amendment census implied.

sources.title: Local and Regional Self-Government Act, official 2013 consolidation
sources.finding: Articles 18,20 establish own regional remit; 35,35 a–b,36 and 71 provide assembly general acts, executive questioning/reports and budget control. Articles 73–76 provide publication, legal effect and executive implementation of general acts affecting legal rights/obligations.
sources.currentness_limits: Official 2013 consolidation read at relevant clauses. Later 2017,2019,2020 changes exist; current ministry explanations corroborate core powers, not every procedural detail.

sources.title: Responsible ministry: local and regional government system, especially FAQ54–56
sources.finding: Current ministry explanation retains own-remit county general acts, official publication/entry into force and implementation through individual rights/obligations decisions. County remit extends across several regional policy sectors.
sources.currentness_limits: Own-government indexed relevant text read; this is a corroborating explanation, not an invented new regional legislative statute.

sources.title: Zagreb Assembly: city statute, English translation, Articles 39–41
sources.finding: Own statute distinguishes representative regulation of self-governing relations from executive tasks, reserves general acts/budget to Assembly and applies the city/county institutional arrangement.
sources.currentness_limits: Historical English translation; old seat counts and currency thresholds are not adopted. Supports functional comparison alongside Constitution/current ministry account.

sources.title: Law 139/2015 on local self-government, Articles 31,72–77,85, government-hosted copy
sources.finding: Qark own function is regional-policy construction/implementation and harmonisation with state policy; further functions are statutory/delegated. Representation is constituted from municipalities. Norms/standards attach to allocated functions and cannot impair constituent municipal autonomy.
sources.currentness_limits: Government-hosted copy, not full 2026 amendment consolidation. No inference that indirectly chosen membership alone disqualifies a legislature.

sources.title: Elbasan qark own statutory functions
sources.finding: Own current-facing functions page reproduces Law 139/2015 Article 31 policy/delegation scope and Article 77 council powers.
sources.currentness_limits: Direct reader 403; own indexed text corroborates statutory remit, not every regional current practice.

sources.title: Hungary Fundamental Law, Ministry of Justice English consolidation, Articles 31–35
sources.finding: Articles 32–33 establish representative-body decree authority, autonomous administration and budgets; Article 32(2) permits local decrees on social relations unregulated by Acts or under statutory authorisation, subject to law.
sources.currentness_limits: Direct download returned a 43-page official PDF expressly as in force 1 October 2026, incorporating 17th Amendment. Informational English translation. Reader timeout was overcome by reading that ordinary public download.

sources.title: Hungary Local Government Act CLXXXIX/2011, current 1 October 2026 text
sources.finding: Sections 3(3), 22–26 expressly give Budapest combined territorial/municipal capacity and broad capital-wide functions. Section 42 reserves decree-making to the representative body. Section 27 assigns counties development/rural-development/coordination; section 10 voluntary tasks does not by itself demonstrate a wider substantive county legislative grant.
sources.currentness_limits: Current native consolidation dated 1 October 2026 read. The old fixed .66 URL is 9 June 2024 and does not govern currentness. The 2026 text uses megye; individual formal-name updates are deferred to metadata stage.

sources.title: Guyana Constitution, Articles 71–78
sources.finding: Article 75 requires autonomous local organs with binding decisions; Article 76 permits statutory revenue powers and Article 77 aligns regional programmes with national plans. This is substantial self-government, not merely advice.
sources.currentness_limits: Official parliamentary indexed constitutional text read; direct PDF reader failed. It must be read with the actual statute implementing local regulation.

sources.title: Guyana Local Democratic Organs Act, Cap 28: 09, ministry law collection
sources.finding: Printed pp. 11–14: section 7 permits local-area regulations/revenue/compulsory acquisition with Minister approval; 13 extends relevant provisions to RDCs. Section 32 applies municipal/district framework with exceptions; 33 requires programmes consistent with national policy. Regulation exists, but within the local-administration framework.
sources.currentness_limits: Official ministry index download read locally; displayed law reprint is LRO 1/2012. The collection’s newer hosting does not make it a 2026 consolidation. Later chair/election amendments are not taken as a new broad legislative grant.

sources.title: Guyana Ministry of Legal Affairs law index, chapter 028: 09
sources.finding: The ministry’s actual Local Democratic Organs Act link designates the downloaded PDF used in this review.
sources.currentness_limits: Link provenance only; collection recency does not certify the reprint date of every chapter.

sources.title: Mongolian Constitution, Articles 57–63, current own Court native text
sources.finding: First-level aimag/capital representative Khurals are self-governing bodies; local decisions are binding within constitutional/statutory competence. Article 62 independent local decisions and 63 resolutions are not erased by the scope exclusion.
sources.currentness_limits: Own Court native text read with official-hosted English statutory translation. No national seat-count or current membership claim is made.

sources.title: Mongolia 2020 revised Units and Governance Act, Articles 4,6,9,21,24,33–35
sources.finding: CRKs decide assigned local economic/social functions, budgets, taxes within statutory limits and governor scrutiny. Article 35.1.14 specifically conditions administrative normative acts on special statutory empowerment and registration; 35.1.16 permits trade/service procedures. These are actual regulatory powers, not a general autonomous regional legislative mandate.
sources.currentness_limits: State legal portal labels English an unofficial translation. Relevant native/translated framework clauses reviewed; not an exhaustive inventory of every sectoral delegation.

classes.decision_basis: Retain 14 eligible higher territorial assemblies under existing substantive regional-ordinance rule. Independent regional norms differ from delegated executive directives. The accepted status does not mean unlimited or sovereign lawmaking; duties still require legal support. Prague qualifies in constitutionally established higher territorial capacity.
legal_citations: Regions Act 129/2000 sections 1–8 and retained assembly/budget framework
classes.consistency_implication: The same own-remit normative/budget/executive-control test must apply to Croatian regional assemblies; an English local-government label cannot decide either outcome.

classes.decision_basis: Change 21 existing exclusions to eligible regional assemblies for project scope: 20 counties plus Zagreb in full combined county capacity. Own-remit general acts, multi-sector regional functions, budget control and executive scrutiny meet the same functional ordinance threshold used for Czech regions. Prior service-only wording under-described their authority.
classes.ordinary_municipality_exclusion_preserve: Other Croatian municipal/city councils stay excluded; performing a particular county service does not itself make an ordinary city a county-tier legislature.
classes.currentness_limits: The 2013 official consolidation is corroborated by current ministry powers explanations. Do not reuse historical executive appointment mechanics, seats or currency values.

classes.decision_basis: Retain 12 qark exclusions because operative own remit is policy coordination/harmonisation and allocated/delegated functions, not a general autonomous regional normative legislature. Binding decisions, standards, finances and executive organisation are acknowledged. Indirect representation is not the disqualifying criterion.
classes.reopening_evidence: An enacted additional grant of substantive autonomous regional legislation beyond policy coordination/delegation; not merely a new stream or council label.

classes.decision_basis: Retain the 19 county exclusions for the narrower territorial-development, rural-development and coordination remit in section 27, while acknowledging real constitutional decree and budget powers. Section 10 voluntary tasks were considered; the reviewed grant does not establish broad normative authority across general regional affairs beyond that county-development remit. Budapest has separately established broad combined capital/territorial functions.
classes.counterevidence_considered: General decree powers and voluntary tasks are real. Exclusion rests on the specific breadth of county competence, rather than denying normative force or requiring sovereign/unlimited power.
classes.currentness_limits: Current 1 October 2026 native section 27 read; current text omits earlier spatial-planning wording and uses megye. Preserve dated earlier wording/name rather than silently treating it as current.

classes.decision_basis: Change Budapest’s existing exclusion to eligible in its combined territorial/capital capacity. The current statute expressly supplies that dual tier; constitutional own-remit decrees and broad cross-district regulatory functions, assembly-reserved lawmaking, budget and executive control satisfy the same combined-capital regional test as Prague and Zagreb. Do not bundle it with the 19 narrow county-development assemblies.
classes.ordinary_municipality_exclusion_preserve: No inclusion of Budapest district councils or ordinary county-right cities; those remain municipal organs. The capital-wide territorial tier and substantive powers must both be present.

classes.decision_basis: Retain 10 RDC exclusions under the local-administration rule. Constitutional autonomy/binding decisions are real. The implemented general local regulation requires ministerial approval and is framed as area management, revenue and local-government acquisition/business; national-policy development alignment remains. Those combined limits distinguish it from an autonomous general regional ordinance assembly.
legal_citations: Local Democratic Organs Act Cap 28: 09 sections 6–7,13,32–33
classes.reopening_evidence: A later enacted broad autonomous regional lawmaking grant or constitutional/statutory decision removing the operative scope limits; new source ownership/playback cannot settle authority.
classes.currentness_limits: The official downloaded chapter is LRO 1/2012, not a certified 2026 consolidation. Preserve this limit; latest hosting date and consultation on reform are not enacted authority changes.

classes.decision_basis: Retain 22 first-level Khural exclusions on the actual local-competence framework: budgets, governor scrutiny, assigned economic/social administration, bounded taxation and specifically empowered administrative normative acts. Constitutional binding resolutions and residual local decisions remain real; they do not establish the broad autonomous regional legislative tier required by the project.
legal_citations: 2020 Units and Governance Act Articles 4,6,9,21,24,33–35, especially 35.1.14
classes.reopening_evidence: A substantive autonomous territorial legislative grant, rather than a further sector-specific administrative rule or the shared Khural name.
classes.currentness_limits: Unofficial English statutory translation on state portal; limits of sectoral normative delegation acknowledged. No claim that every sectoral delegation has been audited.

important_limits: Eligibility here is the catalogue’s functional scope classification, not a claim that the bodies are sovereign/state-legislative parliaments in national constitutional terminology.

A general-act label, budget, elected status or regional name alone is insufficient; evaluate territorial position, breadth/independence of normative competence and representative financial/executive control together.
Only these 99 existing records were compared in this bounded pass; this report does not certify every other excluded class worldwide.
The historical 652 eligible service-review cohort must remain historical. Apply current 22 authority changes as dated overrides, then do separate metadata/media/EPG/rights work.
